manual.win.01.summary: Configure password policy in Local Security Policy or GPO.
steps: Open Group Policy Management Console (gpmc.msc) or Local Security Policy (secpol.msc).
Navigate to the policy setting corresponding to: Ensure 'Minimum password length' is set to 14 or more characters.
Set the value to: 14.
Run `gpupdate /force` and verify effective policy state.
manual.win.01.impact: Ensure compatibility with existing enterprise service accounts.
manual.win.01.authority: Domain Group Policy (GPO) or Local Security Policy.
